article_content: 'Social networking sites have become a prime target for cybercrooks, who use phishing attacks and malware to steal personal information. With millions of users on platforms like Facebook and Twitter, these sites provide a goldmine of data for cyberthieves. According to the FBI, nearly 3,200 account hijacking cases have been reported since 2006, resulting in significant financial losses. Cybercriminals exploit human nature by sending fake messages or links that appear to be from friends in distress, tricking users into divulging sensitive information. As social networking sites continue to grow, they are becoming a lucrative frontier for cybercrime. It is essential for users to be cautious and take necessary precautions to protect their personal information.'

article_content: A materials research team from NIMS and Nagoya University has successfully designed a novel two-step thermal aging schedule for creating nickel-aluminum (Ni-Al) alloys with improved high-temperature strength. Utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, the team identified several dozen effective thermal aging schedules and elucidated their underlying mechanisms, paving the way for future advancements in materials research.

article_content: A vet accidentally shot a zoo employee with a tranquilizer dart during a drill at Loro Parque Zoo in Tenerife, Spain. The 35-year-old employee was dressed as a gorilla as part of the simulation. The vet, who was not aware of the drill, fired the dart, which was designed for a 400lb gorilla, and hit the employee in the leg. The employee was taken to the hospital and has since recovered.

article_content: This is the dramatic moment when Palestinians threw rocks and flares at Israeli police after Islam's third holiest site was raided by officers who claimed it was being used to plan a riot. Israeli police came under a barrage of missiles in clashes in Jerusalem's al-Aqsa mosque compound yesterday, with four protesters arrested. The site in Jerusalem's walled Old City has seen repeated disturbances over the years due to what Palestinians say are fears of an Israeli threat to the site, which Muslims call the Noble Sanctuary. However, Israel denies any such threat and claims that the raid was a preventive measure to maintain order. Jews also revere the site as the location of two destroyed Biblical-era temples.

Policja izraelite u vu një sasi sulme në konflikte në kompleksin e xhamisë së al-Aqsës në Jeruzalem sot, me katër protestues të arrestuar. Vendi ndodh në qytetin e vjetër të Jeruzalemit është e parë një sërishme të përsëritur në vite pasi çfarë nga çfarë për shkakje të mundshme mbi çështjet e tyre që palestinezët thonë se frikësohen nga një kërcënim i Izraelit ndajë vendin që quhet nga myslimanët siçinjtë e Shenjtë e Lartë.
